question: Has Binance published a new official announcement since the retained September 1 SHEIN trigger that literally changes an open ranked mechanism's instrument, fee, reward, yield, settlement, conversion, execution, or program terms?

endpoint_classification.operation: download one bounded current page of the public official Binance latest-announcement catalog
endpoint_classification.security: public unauthenticated read-only CMS GET with no account, credential, order, or mutation semantics
endpoint_classification.source_contract: The official Binance support announcement list is the discovery surface; only exact returned titles, article codes, and publication times may open a separate source-bound gate.

decision.source_gate_only: Parse titles, article codes, and release times offline; ignore marketing language and do not infer deployment or economics from a title.
decision.conditional_next_step: Advance at most the highest-ranked genuinely new literal trigger through a separately frozen cheapest decisive source or structural gate; otherwise record a no-trigger result without any market-data request.

retry_policy: This exact catalog-page GET is one-use. Preserve any HTTP error, empty response, or missing-term response and do not retry an alias. Do not revisit titles at or before the retained prior-observation cutoff, and do not request prices, funding, books, accounts, or credentials unless a separate literal trigger and frozen cheapest decisive gate justify them.
